name: ESP32WiFiPortal
description: ESP32 WiFi configuration portal with built-in web server. Connects to a saved network on boot, falls back to an Access Point with a configuration form, and exposes the WebServer for additional handlers. Credentials live in NVS via the Preferences API; the config-form HTML is compiled into the firmware at build time.
keywords: esp32, wifi, portal, captive, webserver, nvs, preferences, configuration
